entries.event: A. F. Gilmore acquires the dairy property that later becomes the Third and Fairfax entertainment district
Oil discovery transforms the Gilmore dairy land into an oil field and automobile-economy asset
Los Angeles Motordrome opens at Playa del Rey, a one-mile wooden speedway
Ed Fletcher stages the promotional road race that helps sell the San Diego to Yuma route
The first plank tracks are laid across the Imperial Sand Dunes
California replaces the narrow wheel paths with an eight-foot sectional plank road
Beverly Hills Speedway opens
Beverly Hills Speedway closes as the land becomes more valuable; Culver City Speedway opens
A paved road replaces the Plank Road corridor across the dunes
Culver City board-track racing ends and the land is platted for housing and a park
Gilmore Stadium and Original Farmers Market open at Third and Fairfax
Pan-Pacific Auditorium opens near the Gilmore complex
Southern California Timing Association forms to organize dry-lake speed trials
Gilmore Field opens for the Hollywood Stars
Solar Aircraft begins building midget racers in San Diego, pending final production receipt
Hot Rod publishes its first issue; Gilmore Drive-In opens on the future Grove parcel
Gilmore Stadium holds its final midget season and the property is sold for television development
Gilmore grandstands come down while Television City rises
Television City opens on the former Gilmore Stadium parcel
Willow Springs opens in the high desert
Lions Drag Strip opens in Wilmington
Paramount Raceway opens at the movie ranch
Paramount Raceway closes; Riverside and the Gardena Ascot Park open
Orange County International Raceway opens; Pit Stop is photographed around Los Angeles and Ascot
The Love Bug photographs racing material at several California locations
Ontario Motor Speedway opens
Lions Drag Strip closes; Pan-Pacific Auditorium closes
Long Beach stages its first Grand Prix as a Formula 5000 race
Formula One arrives at Long Beach
Ontario Motor Speedway closes; Xanadu turns the derelict Pan-Pacific facade into a fantasy roller disco
Orange County International Raceway closes
Long Beach switches from Formula One to CART
Riverside holds its final major NASCAR weekend
Riverside closes completely and the Pan-Pacific Auditorium burns
Ascot Park holds its final events
Irwindale Speedway opens
The author photographs the Big 3 Parts Exchange at Qualcomm Stadium
Irwindale Speedway closes after its final December event
Willow Springs and the Long Beach street race remain active counterexamples to complete erasure
